label: prop:global-gluing
title: Global gluing via twisted quantization
html: Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with substrate parameter q. The local deformations of the Frobenius–Hopf object A induce a twisted associative deformation admitting a unique global gluing via Yekutieli's twisted quantization map [yekutieli2008, yekutieli2010]: the direct limit algebra \mathcal{A}_\infty (direct limit algebra) is a well-defined global section of a sheaf of twisted deformation algebras on the underlying site \mathcal{S}.
heading: Proposition
